🔔 Farriimaha (Notifications) — Dhab ah
⚠️ Farriimaha OS-ka (telefoonka/computerka) lagama furi karo si toos ah

Waxaad file-ka ka furtay Downloads/File Manager (`content://` ama `file://`) — browser-ku ammaan darteed wuu xannibaa farriimaha OS-ka meeshaas. Si aad u hesho ogeysiisyo dhab ah oo telefoonka/computerka kaaga soo baxa (sida sawirka labaad), waa inaad file-ka ka furtaa:

  • Website hosted ah (tusaale: GitHub Pages — https://...)
  • Ama local server (tusaale http://localhost)
📅 Sii wad jadwalkaaga

Ogolow farriimaha si aan kuu xasuusinno marka hawlahaaga la qorsheeyay ay waqtigoodu gaaro — Salaadaha, Jadwalka, Fasallada, iyo Xasuusinooyinka gaarka ah.
